name: Researcher (SYNTHESIZE phase) → Reviewer (research mode)
description: ADR-041 Slice 2D-3 pure-research arc terminal handoff. Fires when researcher-synthesize terminates with decide(action=emit) — the addendum 2026-05-12 path for deployments that do NOT run an architect phase (e.g. e2e-research-mode-transition.json). The spawned reviewer loads reviewer-research/ persona fragments and grades the research artifact (typed emit_research_artifact payload: actors/integration_points/tasks/addressed_gaps/open_gaps/test_harness/substrate_mutations/revision). The phase-validator's allowed-edges table includes synthesize→emit specifically for this arc.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.reviewer-research
on_enter.prompt:
The researcher (SYNTHESIZE phase) at loop $entity.instance has emitted a research artifact via emit_research_artifact + decide(action=emit).

Iteration 1 — call read_loop_result on $entity.instance to load the synthesize phase's narrative terminal. The typed payload is on the researcher's loop entity; the structural shape (actors/integration_points/tasks/addressed_gaps/open_gaps/test_harness/substrate_mutations/revision) is the contract you grade against per reviewer-research/10-evaluation-contract.md.

Iteration 2 — apply the research-mode checklist. If every required field is present, well-formed, and grounded in the gathered evidence, call decide(action="approved", reason="<one-sentence summary citing the revision token>"). If a required field is missing or evidence is thin, call decide(action="insufficient", reason="<bullet list of gaps>"); chain.recovery.proceed (ADR-040) gates retries through 02-reviewer-rejected-retry-research.json. Use decide(action="needs_clarification", reason=..., retry_hint=...) only when the artifact's intent is genuinely ambiguous.

metadata.pattern: pure-research arc terminal: researcher-synthesize emits research artifact → reviewer-research evaluates. No further hand-off on approval (research-only deployments treat this as terminal). Rejection routes through 02-reviewer-rejected-retry-research.json which respawns researcher-plan with the reviewer's reason.
metadata.phasevalidator_edge: Requires synthesize→emit in phasevalidator allowedEdges (added in Slice 2D-3a). Without that edge, the validator rejects the transition and no rule fires.
